skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and theories of investment economics, including investment theories, principles of state management of investment, and the nature and sources of investment capital.
Develop skills to identify and solve problems in the field of investment, and to analyze fundamental issues of investment.
Manage investment activities, including state management, and understand the outcomes and effectiveness of investments.
Apply knowledge to solve practical problems in investment.
Work independently and in groups to solve investment-related problems.
Develop the ability to learn independently and accumulate experience to enhance professional competence.
Maintain discipline in class, follow class rules, and demonstrate responsibility in group activities.
